clue.text: Obtaining treatment by a medical specialist?

definitions.meaning: read whimsically as PRO plus CURING: healing done by a professional

explanation.surface: Getting care from a consultant doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the word into PRO (a professional) and CURING (treatment); the question mark flags the pun.
explanation.definitionFit: To procure is to acquire, so procuring means acquiring.

clue.text: Outgoing conservationists in rightful situation

indicators.note: the conservationists' letters are placed inside the word for rightful

parts.note: real can mean genuine, legitimate, rightful
NT is the National Trust, a British heritage conservation charity

explanation.surface: Departing conservationists find themselves in their proper place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outgoing' looks like an adjective for the conservationists but is the definition: a rental is money going out. 'situation' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A rental payment is an expense, money paid out regularly.

clue.text: No bold playwright!

definitions.meaning: someone with no boldness is a craven person, and the phrase also sounds like Noël
Noël ..., the English dramatist of Private Lives

explanation.walkthrough: 'No bold' doubles as a sound-pun on Noël, the playwright's first name.
explanation.definitionFit: A craven person lacks courage; Noël Coward was an English dramatist.

clue.text: Back around the man and try again

indicators.note: the word for back goes around the word for the man

parts.note: the rear is the back
he is the pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: Back round the man and have another go.
explanation.definitionFit: To hear a case again in court is to retry it.

clue.text: Sees wrong section

indicators.note: wrong suggests the letters of section are put in a mistaken order

explanation.surface: Someone spots a section that has gone wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: To notice something is to see or spot it.

clue.text: Love to order and plug Oriental drink

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like O
to range is to arrange or put in order
a plug is an advertisement, an ad
E for East, the Orient

explanation.surface: A lover arranging things and promoting an Eastern drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Orangeade is a sweet fizzy fruit drink.

clue.text: He worries employees in high places

indicators.note: the employees are placed inside the high places

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hilltop, and two of them give the plural
men are workers, employees

explanation.surface: A man who frets about the staff working at altitude.
explanation.walkthrough: A tor is a rocky hilltop on Dartmoor and in Cornwall; the plural 'places' supplies two of them.
explanation.definitionFit: A tormentor is one who harasses or troubles someone else.

clue.text: Helpers in disaster stock up again

indicators.note: a disaster leaves the letters of helpers in jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: Aid workers in a catastrophe restock their supplies.
explanation.definitionFit: To replenish is to refill or restore supplies.

clue.text: Cutting a circle in wood

indicators.note: the circle sits inside the word for a wood

parts.note: a grove is a small wood
O is shaped like a circle

explanation.surface: Carving a ring into a piece of timber.
explanation.definitionFit: A groove is a channel or furrow cut into a surface.

clue.text: This heroine owns awfully little, note

indicators.note: awfully tells us the letters of owns are badly arranged

parts.note: a whit is a tiny amount
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A heroine who possesses very little apart from a note.
explanation.definitionFit: The fairy-tale princess with the seven dwarfs is a famous heroine.

clue.text: Man is a tool-using so Carlyle said

definitions.text: Man is a tool-using so Carlyle said

parts.words: Man is a tool-using so Carlyle said
parts.note: fill in the missing last word of Thomas Carlyle's famous description of mankind in Sartor Resartus

explanation.surface: Quoting the Victorian writer Carlyle on what humans are.
explanation.definitionFit: Carlyle wrote that a human is a creature that uses tools, completing his famous quotation.

clue.text: The leading lady

parts.note: not an actress but the woman who heads a family or tribe

explanation.definitionFit: A matriarch is a woman who rules a family or community.

clue.text: A Quaker getting no backing colours

parts.note: William Penn, the Quaker founder of Pennsylvania

indicators.note: backing means the word no is read from end to start

explanation.surface: A Quaker refuses to support the flag.
explanation.definitionFit: A pennon is a long flag, and colours are a regiment's flags.

clue.text: Snappy devil, the worker holding a draw!

parts.note: an imp is a little devil

indicators.note: the worker insect holds the draw inside it

parts.note: a worker ant is the classic crossword worker
a tie is a drawn game

explanation.surface: A bad-tempered devil, an employee who manages a draw.
explanation.definitionFit: An irritable, short-tempered person is quick to snap.

clue.text: Press notes about what may be dug up

parts.note: to iron clothes is to press them

indicators.note: about signals the letters of notes are moved around

explanation.surface: A newspaper reporting about something buried.
explanation.definitionFit: Ironstone is an iron-bearing rock that is mined.

clue.text: Many is the offer of a stretcher

parts.note: D is 500 in Roman numerals, a large number
taken as written
a tender is a formal offer

explanation.surface: A question about how many accept the offer of a stretcher.
explanation.definitionFit: A distender is something that swells or stretches things out.

clue.text: Silly sap-a crawler

indicators.note: silly suggests the letters of sap are put into a foolish order

explanation.definitionFit: The asp is a small venomous snake, a creature that crawls.

clue.text: British article on the French porter

parts.note: a is the English indefinite article
le is French for the

explanation.surface: An English article placed in front of the French article for a doorman.
explanation.walkthrough: Porter is the dark beer, not a doorman.
explanation.definitionFit: Porter is a type of dark beer, a kind of ale.

clue.text: An Irishman gets little C encouragement

definitions.meaning: ..., a typical Irish name, short for Patrick
a ... on the back is a small gesture of approval

explanation.surface: An Irishman barely gets any support.
explanation.definitionFit: Pat is the stereotypical crossword Irishman; a pat on the back is modest praise.

clue.text: A Roman writer full of fighting spirit

explanation.surface: An ancient poet who was spoiling for a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: Martial was a Latin poet of epigrams; martial also means warlike.

clue.text: A dour eccentric America finds hard to bear

indicators.note: eccentric suggests the letters of a dour are arranged oddly

parts.note: US is the United States

explanation.surface: A gloomy oddball finds the United States hard to endure.
explanation.definitionFit: Something arduous is difficult and demands effort.

clue.text: Don't go without food in the attempt to slim

indicators.note: in signals that the letters lie inside the words the attempt

explanation.surface: Advice to dieters: keep eating while trying to lose weight.
explanation.definitionFit: To feed oneself is the opposite of fasting.

clue.text: A few take a cereal -it's A just plain greed

parts.note: V is five in Roman numerals, a small number
rice is a cereal grain

explanation.surface: Grabbing several helpings of cereal is pure gluttony.
explanation.definitionFit: Avarice is an excessive desire for wealth, a form of greed.

clue.text: Relative acquiring bronzed back in time

indicators.note: the reversed colour goes inside the word for time

parts.note: an age is a period of time

indicators.note: back means the word for bronzed is read the other way

parts.note: tan means bronzed by the sun

explanation.surface: A family member getting a suntan over time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Relative' looks like an adjective but is a noun here, a kinsman; 'acquiring' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An agnate is a kinsman related through the male line.

clue.text: The person letting losers go to the dogs

indicators.note: go to the dogs means fall into ruin, so the letters of losers are wrecked into a new order

explanation.surface: A landlord letting failures go to ruin.
explanation.definitionFit: A lessor is a landlord who grants a lease.

clue.text: Through engaging in hot air they stare

indicators.note: the word for through is engaged inside the word for hot air

parts.note: gas is idle talk, hot air
per means through or by means of

explanation.surface: Onlookers gawping at a balloon full of hot air.
explanation.definitionFit: Gapers are people who gape, gazing open-mouthed.

clue.text: Sound guy at the wheel?

indicators.note: sound tells us the word for guy is heard, not seen

parts.note: a fellow is a chap or guy

explanation.surface: A dependable chap driving a car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like praise of the driver but signals the homophone; 'at the wheel' is not driving but part of a wheel.
explanation.definitionFit: A felloe is the outer rim of a wooden wheel, where spokes are fixed.

clue.text: Following the shooting they expect developments

definitions.text: Following the shooting they expect developments

parts.words: Following the shooting they expect developments
parts.note: reads like detectives after a gunfight, but the shooting is filming and the developments are photographic

explanation.surface: Investigators awaiting news after a gun crime.
explanation.definitionFit: Film operators shoot footage and then await the processing of the film.

clue.text: Aim of popular nurse

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
to tend is to nurse or care for

explanation.surface: The goal of a well-liked nurse.
explanation.definitionFit: To aim at something is to plan or mean to do it.

clue.text: There's charm in the girl, even though she can't get the letters right!

indicators.note: the charm is placed inside the word for the girl

parts.note: miss is a young woman
a spell is a magic charm

explanation.surface: A charming girl who is nonetheless a poor speller.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who misspells writes words with wrong letters.

clue.text: A Continental place sent an assortment

indicators.note: an assortment is a mixed collection, so the letters of sent an are mixed

explanation.surface: A European town has sent a mixed selection.
explanation.definitionFit: Nantes is a city in western France.

clue.text: Newsmen at the heart of the action can appear dispirited

indicators.note: the newsmen sit in the middle of the word for the action

parts.note: a deed is an act or action
the press are journalists collectively

explanation.surface: Reporters in the thick of events look downcast.
explanation.definitionFit: Depressed means low in spirits, gloomy.
